verdicts.tldr: 55 outline icons ship with a 1.3 currentColor outline on fills and dots their source leaves unstroked, so battery, menu-horizontal, lock, calendar-* and the like render heavier than designed
verdicts.details: iconHead returns iconHeadStroke for any symbol whose root is exactly {viewBox 0 0 21 21, stroke-width 1.3}, and that head sets stroke="currentColor" plus round caps/joins on the <svg>. The body copier only drops attributes equal to the inherited value and never writes stroke="none" where the source had no stroke, so a shape with no stroke in its source now inherits one: vendored.svg ico-menu-horizontal is <g fill="currentColor"><circle r="1"/>x3</g> with no stroke anywhere, and icons_gen.go:307 emits the same body under iconHeadStroke, so each r=1 dot gains a 1.3 outline and draws at radius 1.65. The icon table is new in this PR (no icon file at the merge base), so the diff introduces it; TestIconTable stays green because it compares the generator with its own output. Same root cause as candidate 11. Fix: seed the generator's inherited map with SVG initial values (stroke none, linecap butt, linejoin miter) and write the attribute wherever the source's effective value differs from what iconHeadStroke hands down, then regenerate icons_gen.go and ICONS.svg.

Base: git ls-tree 41841e92f markdown/ | grep -c icon -> 0, the generator and table do not exist there. Not raised in any PR thread (gh api comments/reviews grep for stroke|fill: no hit).

verdicts.tldr: a page with an empty `##` heading and any icon heading gets two headings with id "heading", so the TOC link and #heading anchor of the second jump to the empty one
verdicts.details: iconHeadingIDTransformer builds a fresh newLinearIDs() and regenerates every heading's id, but the guard `h.Lines().Len() > 0` skips an empty ATX heading, which keeps goldmark's id "heading" without that id ever being registered in the fresh set. The next heading that slugs to "heading" (the text Heading, an icon-only heading, CJK-only text) is then handed "heading" again. Without any icon the transformer returns early and goldmark gives [heading heading-1], so the icon on an unrelated later heading is what breaks uniqueness. Magnitude is small: it needs an empty ATX heading on the page. Fix: for a heading with no lines, register its kept id with ids.Put, or regenerate it with ids.Generate(nil, ast.KindHeading).

verdicts.tldr: an icon-only link inside a heading that already has an earlier unlabeled icon loses its add-label hint, so the author is not told the link has no accessible name
verdicts.details: When the heading's first icon renders, aloneInNamedParent walks the whole heading, descending into the nested link, and sets c.hintDone = true on every icon it meets while assigning only first.hint. When the link's own icon renders, its parent resolves to the link, n.hintDone is already true, and it returns n.hint, which is false, so no hint comment is written although the link holds nothing naming it. Without an earlier icon in the heading the link's icon renders first, walks only the link and gets the hint. Banded Nit: what is lost is an invisible author-facing HTML comment; the rendered page and its accessibility are the same either way. Fix: in the walk, return ast.WalkSkipChildren on a nested namedByContent node other than parent, so a nested link answers for itself.
verdicts.evidence: Head, finder artifact copied to markdown/zz_b3_hint_test.go, go test -count=1 -run TestB3LinkHintLostInsideHeading -v .: control `## Title [<gno-icon name="star" />](/r/x)` passes its Fatalf guard (hint present); 'an icon-only link inside a heading got no hint: "## <gno-icon name=\"star\" /> Title [<gno-icon name=\"star\" />](/r/x)\n"' and the two-link variant; --- FAIL. Read: ext_icons.go `case *Icon: c.hintDone = true; if first == nil { first = c }` inside ast.Walk(parent, ...) with no skip on nested links, then `if n.hintDone { return n.hint }`. Base: aloneInNamedParent does not exist at 41841e92f. Not raised in any thread.

verdicts.tldr: 58 of 491 shipped glyphs paint a shape differently from their source: battery's fill bar gains an outline that nearly closes its gap to the frame, and keypad, lock and wallet dots thicken
verdicts.details: Same root cause as candidate 1, counted per glyph: iconHead maps the 21px stroke-width 1.3 root to iconHeadStroke, whose stroke="currentColor" and round caps/joins every shape inherits unless the body overrides it, and the copier never writes stroke="none". vendored.svg:149 ico-battery has <g fill="none"> with the frame stroked per path and the bar `<path d="m3 2h9..." fill="currentColor"/>` unstroked; icons_gen.go:35 drops the per-path strokes (now inherited) and leaves the bar with no stroke attribute, so it inherits a 1.3 outline. 55 glyphs gain a stroke on fill-only shapes and 3 more switch cap/join from butt/miter to round. Fix: as candidate 1, write stroke="none" (and butt/miter) wherever the source's effective value differs from the head's, then regenerate the table and the goldens that pin the thickened glyphs.
